fullPassage: It was lunchtime, and a group of us were picnicking with our kids. Three-year-old Jack was having a tantrum in front of his father. His dad picked him up, held his arms pressed against his body so he couldn't wiggle around, put his face close to the toddler's, and said, "Now tell me what you want. Don't whine or hit, just tell me, and then I can help you." Jack was pouty for another moment; then he said, "I'm very hungry, Daddy, and I don't want any of those things for lunch." Having witnessed this episode, Marsha later asked Jack's dad if he knew what the youngster had wanted. "Of course," he said. "But I wanted him to tell me. I say all the time to him, 'Use your words.' So does my wife, but she means, 'Don't whine.' I mean, 'Explain what you want.'"

② held: picked와 나란히 이어지는 과거동사라 held가 맞아요. ✅

③ pressed: 'his arms pressed against his body'는 '팔이 눌린 채로'라는 과거분사라 맞아요. ✅

④ witnessing → witnessed: 'Having ___ this episode'는 '이 장면을 목격한 뒤'라는 완료분사구문이에요. Having 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 witnessed가 맞아요. witnessing은 틀려요. ❌ ← 정답
det.tip: Having + 과거분사(완료분사구문): Having witnessed(목격한 뒤).

questions.passage: It was lunchtime, and a group of us were picnicking with our kids. Three-year-old Jack was having a tantrum in front of his father. His dad picked him up, held his arms pressed against his body so he couldn't wiggle around, put his face close to the toddler's, and said, "Now tell me what you want. Don't whine or hit, just tell me, and then I can help you." Jack was pouty for another moment; then he said, "I'm very hungry, Daddy, and I don't want any of those things for lunch." Having witnessed this episode, Marsha later asked Jack's dad if he knew what the youngster had wanted. "Of course," he said. "But I wanted him to tell me. I say all the time to him, 'Use your words.' So does my wife, but she means, 'Don't whine.' I mean, 'Explain what you want.'"
questions.stem: 위 글에서 Jack이 점심 직전 자신의 상태를 설명하며 한 말을, 'I'm __________ __________'의 빈칸에 들어갈 두 단어로 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (2단어, 영어로)

det.tip: I'm ___ , Daddy 로 시작하는 Jack의 말을 확인하세요.

아이에게는 규칙보다 자유를 더 많이 주어야 한다.

[조건]

det.korean: 아버지가 아이에게 바란 것: 스스로 말하기.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- But(그러나): 앞 문장과 대조하여 문장을 열어요
- I wanted(주어+동사): 나는 원했다
- him to tell me: 'want+목적어+to부정사(…가 ~하기를 원하다)' 구조로 '그가 내게 말하기를'
따라서 'But I wanted him to tell me'가 돼요.
det.tip: want + 사람 + to부정사: wanted him to tell me(그가 내게 말하기를 원했다).
